name: Ama no Miko Hime
source:
Main character loses parents in childhood and lives with his grandfather. After grandfather death he decides to move back to home town where aunt and three shrine maidens wait for his return.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公幼年失去双亲，此后一直与祖父生活。祖父去世后，他决定搬回故乡，姨母和三名巫女正在那里等待他的归来。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
